verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a real-time infrastructure platform with server APIs and a CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents acting on many rooms, participants, agents, or deployments at once. The CLI's server API access, test traffic generation, telephony dispatch rules, and auto-recording on room creation are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
